stances_toward.note: Algiers hosts the Front's headquarters and the Tindouf refugee camps and has supported it since 1975 with arms, training and money (MEI, Nov 2025). It insists on the Sahrawi right to self-determination and a MINURSO referendum (MFA text on S/RES/2797) and did not vote on the resolution endorsing autonomy as the basis for talks. De facto patron-client alignment without treaty text, hence ally by the stable-de-facto-alignment clause; the Polisario's dependence on Algerian soil is the structure. Bond - affinity: anti-colonial solidarity, not kinship.

stances_toward.note: Our reading, confidence C: no source in this pass uses the word. The grade rests on structure: the Polisario claims a state on the territory Rabat calls its own, rejects any process that predetermines autonomy, and has been in armed conflict with Morocco since the ceasefire collapsed in Nov 2020 (date from the Wikipedia infobox of the 2020 clashes; no citation retrieved), with Algeria backing it. Rabat denies the Sahrawi Republic's existence as a state. Against 'adversary': the Polisario sat at the US-convened talks of Feb 2026, so the next pass should test 'rival'. Bond - grievance: an open dispute over the territory.
